about: What the Consumer answers about its Row Marks for the header and the count display (ADR-0043). From dotnet/tests/ExGrid.Tests/RowMarkRuleTests.cs.

cases.name: ADR-0043: the counts are read back, and every mark is those inside the result and those outside it
